text:
Jamal: Heads up — I need to run a quick debug on prod to trace a memory spike for /embed-service. Asking for guidance on safe steps and approval. Ticket INF-4587.
Maria: Oncall — 👍 You need ephemeral access via Okta this week. Give me the exact commands you plan to run. Also will need the ticket ID (INF-4587).
Jamal: INF-4587. Plan: connect to bastion, curl internal /metrics endpoint, tail the app logs for 10m, collect heap profile with pprof, then exit. Will not dump full logs off-box.
Alex: Quick security checklist: 1) redact PII before copying logs off-host; 2) avoid including any API keys in captures; 3) use our redaction tool `log-redact` or run simple sed patterns. If you need a heapdump, prefer `pprof` over raw memory dumps. Also ask for approval from Product Security.
Chris: From runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prod-debug — follow the "safe-debug" section. For ephemeral role request use Okta -> 'Temporary Prod Access' and set duration to 60m. I'll approve INF-4587 now.
oncall-bot: Pager triage: Incident #INC-2026 assigned to eng-oncall (severity: P3).
Jamal: :eyes: will avoid copying any raw traces. Example redaction command I plan to run:
```
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g' app.log > app.redacted.log
sed -E "s/(token|api_key)=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+/[REDACTED_KEY]/g" app.redacted.log > app.redacted2.log
```
Maria: Use the `log-redact` binary instead if available: `log-redact --input app.log --rules ./prod-redact.rules --out app.redacted.log`. Also add a line in the ticket that you've run it.
Alex: If you need to run `strace` or attach a debugger, escalate to eng-platform and schedule a maintenance window. No live ptrace on customer-facing nodes without approval.
Chris: Approved. I set Okta session for Jamal, expires +60m. Jamal: confirm when you're done and paste the redacted filename in INF-4587. Also run `sha256sum` on the redacted file and attach.
sre-docs-bot: Copied runbook snippet into thread: 'When collecting logs for debugging, mask PII, never copy secrets, use ephemeral roles, minimum time window, and document steps in ticket.'
Jamal: Thanks all. Starting now. Will post `app.redacted.log.sha256` when finished.
oncall-bot: Reminder: break-glass policy active: if you need longer access, must submit emergency approval, ping @Alex and @Maria. :lock:
